description: This script manages the startup process for a React frontend project, detecting if the environment is a CI environment and redirecting to static serving to prevent server termination. Otherwise, it initiates a development server with specified memory limits.

methods.name: isCI
methods.description: Checks if the current environment is a CI environment based on environment variables.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Synchronously runs a command with arguments, inheriting stdio, and exits with the command's status code.
